problems.description: Attackers send deceptive emails impersonating trusted entities to trick users into submitting their login credentials on fake websites.
risk_reduction: Implement multi-factor authentication (MFA) across all accounts
Deploy advanced email filtering and anti-phishing tools
Conduct regular user awareness training and phishing simulations

problems.description: Highly targeted phishing attacks aimed at specific individuals or roles within an organization to gain access to sensitive information or systems.
risk_reduction: Use threat intelligence to identify targeted campaigns
Limit publicly available personal information on social media
Train employees to recognize social engineering tactics

problems.description: Attackers compromise or spoof business email accounts to request fraudulent wire transfers or sensitive data from employees.
risk_reduction: Verify unusual requests through secondary communication channels
Enable email authentication protocols like DMARC, DKIM, and SPF
Monitor email traffic for anomalies and implement anomaly detection

problems.description: Attackers inject malicious SQL code into input fields to manipulate backend databases, potentially extracting or altering sensitive data.
risk_reduction: Use parameterized queries and prepared statements
Validate and sanitize all user inputs
Employ web application firewalls (WAF) to detect injection attempts

problems.description: Attackers exploit SQL injection vulnerabilities without direct feedback by inferring database information through application behavior changes.
risk_reduction: Implement strict input validation and output encoding
Limit database error messages exposed to users
Conduct regular security testing including blind injection scenarios

problems.description: Attackers use UNION SQL operators to combine malicious queries with legitimate ones, extracting data from other database tables.
risk_reduction: Restrict database user permissions to minimum required
Use ORM frameworks that abstract SQL queries
Continuously monitor and log database queries for suspicious patterns
